targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "coldchain_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temp_c")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "temperature")

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "coldchain_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "humidity_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "humidity")

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    device_id,
    gedung,
    ruang,
    status,
    last_seen
FROM devices
ORDER BY device_id;

panels.description: Daftar alert suhu, tingkat keparahan, dan status penanganan pada seluruh perangkat cold chain.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    alert_id,
    device_id,
    alert_type,
    severity,
    message,
    status,
    triggered_at,
    acknowledged_at,
    resolved_at
FROM alert_events
ORDER BY triggered_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Alert Monitoring.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    alert_id,
    device_id,
    alert_type,
    severity,
    status,
    triggered_at,
    message
FROM alert_events
ORDER BY triggered_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    alert_id,
    device_id,
    alert_type,
    severity,
    status,
    triggered_at,
    message
FROM alert_events
WHERE alert_type = 'TEMP_ESCALATED'
ORDER BY triggered_at DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    status,
    COUNT(*) AS total
FROM alert_events
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_alert
FROM alert_events;
